## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a security fix has a regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] README and `action.yml` descriptions updated if inputs or behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private data in the diff or screenshots
- [ ] Reviewed the security impact (new inputs, auth, file/network access, dependencies)
